Subject: Follow-up: MAP draft and SOC 2 evidence timeline

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the demo and the MAP discussion this morning. Ava from Ledgerly here. As mentioned on the call, security review and a SOC 2–oriented evidence package are blockers for our procurement team. Two asks to keep momentum: 

1) Can you share a short MAP draft that lists milestones, owners, and target dates for the security/SOC 2 deliverable? We want to align internal stakeholders.
2) Please provide your SOC 2 questionnaire (or the questions you expect us to answer) and a baseline list of the evidence artifacts Redwood will need from Ledgerly, with suggested due dates.

Proposed timeline from our side: security review week of Aug 24 (we can do a 45m call), and target contract close by Sept 30. If Redwood can confirm owners and a few definitive due dates this week, we can lock internal calendar invites.

I attached our internal questionnaire to give context. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Thanks,
Ava Rogers
Head of Security Programs — Ledgerly
ava@ledgerly.io

Attachment: Ledgerly_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

Ava —

Appreciate the clear asks and the questionnaire — that helps a lot. Attached is a brief MAP draft focused on the security milestone plus a CSV template for evidence collection. Summary below (high level):

- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 evidence delivery
  - Owner (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra (SRE lead) — rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
  - Owner (Ledgerly): TBD (security contact)
  - Deliverables: completed questionnaire, list of evidence artifacts, secure evidence drop link, signed DPA (if needed)
  - Suggested due dates: questionnaire completed by 2026-08-17, ledgerly evidence list by 2026-08-20, Redwood provides final evidence ask + secure drop by 2026-08-24.
  - Dependency: Ledgerly legal signoff on DPA (if required) and availability of security SME for review call.

- Target close date for deal: 2026-09-30 (as discussed)

Next steps from our side: Rishi will review Ledgerly questionnaire and populate the Redwood evidence ask matrix; Priyom will prepare a secure intake link and the evidence template. Can you confirm your security contact and whether Aug 24 works for a review call? If Aug 24 is tight, suggest Aug 18–20 slot options.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Draft_Ledgerly_v1.pdf, evidence-ask-template.csv

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once you confirm the contact.

Best,
Chloe Martin

chloe_martin@redwood.com
